name: Speeding
overview: Scripture teaches that a lack of self-control and wisdom leads to harmful actions, as seen in Proverbs where folly delights in mischief and an uncontrolled spirit is likened to a defenseless city. Speeding, as an expression of impatience or disregard for order, contradicts the call to exercise wise stewardship over our behavior. Believers are reminded to submit to governing authorities, which God has established, and to live in a way that reflects the love and eternal purpose revealed through Christ.
